title: Garlic Cheese Stuffed Hawaiian Rolls
description: A delicious and cheesy garlic bread made with King's Hawaiian rolls, stuffed with mozzarella cheese, and topped with a garlic butter mixture.
steps: Take the King's Hawaiian rolls and place them in a dish.
Cut two slits down the middle of each roll, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Stuff mozzarella cheese into the slits of each roll.
In a bowl, mix softened butter, minced garlic, chopped parsley, and garlic salt.
Spread the garlic butter mixture over the tops of the rolls.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes.
Let the rolls cool slightly before serving.
notes:
Optional: Add more garlic or parsley to taste.
